commits.unit: Separate Linux services, installers, diagnostics, images and production supervisor acceptance.

deviations: Standalone Python stdlib maintenance commands replace proposed main-binary subcommands. This avoids manager main.rs and agent config.rs conflicts and adds no Cargo dependencies. Services and maintenance acquire the same flock; the Rust integration test proves exclusion.

The shared private filesystem recovery implementation lives in manager/packaging/recovery.py and is copied into each separate installed component library. No shared link protocol schema is introduced.

Coordinated backup stops the manager first to freeze admission because no admission-freeze endpoint exists in the baseline. It then stops the worker, verifies both bundles and only restarts on explicit --restart-after-success.

The source SQLite connection uses existing-file read-write mode under the exclusive service lock, because read-only WAL reopening without sidecars failed on the system SQLite. Snapshot verification uses immutable read-only mode.

The procfs observer excludes the systemd-reported user-manager PID and only its matching-parent, matching-cgroup PAM helper. Both are nondumpable infrastructure on Ubuntu; every other inaccessible same-account process fails closed.
goal: Implement the M06 recovery and separate Linux packaging workstream without touching connector ownership or real owner state.
incomplete_gates: Independent review is assigned to the parent. No subagents or self-review substitute was used.

Connector credential decryption/use after restore awaits connector-owner integration. The whole SQLite database is included, but the standalone test proves provider credential usability rather than inventing connector APIs.
No real Proxmox service was altered. Native installation and acceptance on the existing x86_64 Proxmox pair remain parent-owned.
Rootful Podman is not installed locally. Its profile is supplied but unverified and is not claimed supported without running container-acceptance.py.
Docker Linux x86_64 acceptance, complete Computer and Vibe runtime installation, and actual authenticated connector execution remain parent-owned.
The coordinated pair script was syntax/help checked but was not executed against remote services.
Manager TLS/service files outside the state root remain separate private deployment inputs. Bundles do not encrypt plaintext history, Markdown or artifact content.
Worker external roots restore only to original absolute paths. Publication across roots is not atomic; partial publication is reported and services must remain stopped.

Worker retained-identity cutover requires retiring the original instance; the flag cannot prove a disconnected VM is off. Unselected tools/OS/host state are excluded, while selected tool bytes and executable modes are restored.
